name: LiteLLM model gateway
degradesTo: LÉLU's existing AIProviderRegistry talks to each provider directly. No second registry is created; the gateway is only a routing layer in front of it.

health.detail: LITELLM_BASE_URL is unset — provider routing uses the existing registry directly.

name: OpenFGA relationship authorization
degradesTo: The in-process RelationshipStore (same tuple shape) enforces device/session/owner relationships. Server-side tuple writes are not shared between instances.

health.detail: OPENFGA_API_URL is unset — relationship checks use the in-process store.

name: Temporal durable workflows
degradesTo: WorkflowEngine runs durably in LÉLU's own store with checkpoints and recorded step state; there is no distributed worker recovery across processes.

health.detail: TEMPORAL_ADDRESS is unset — long-running work stays on the in-process workflow engine.

name: Pipecat voice pipeline
degradesTo: VoiceEngine (the existing Web Speech path) handles listen/speak with barge-in; no streaming WebRTC transport is available.

health.detail: PIPECAT_BASE_URL is unset — voice uses the existing browser speech engines.

name: whisper.cpp speech recognition
degradesTo: Browser speech recognition (VoiceEngine.transcriptionTransport), which needs the platform's own recogniser.

health.detail: WHISPER_BASE_URL is unset — transcription uses the browser recogniser when one exists.

name: Kokoro text-to-speech
degradesTo: Browser speech synthesis, which is what LÉLU speaks through today.

health.detail: KOKORO_BASE_URL is unset — speech synthesis uses the browser's own voices (0 in a headless runtime).

name: OpenHands engineering backend
degradesTo: The local engineering runtime: sandbox copies, whitelisted commands, real test execution on this machine.

health.detail: OPENHANDS_BASE_URL is unset — engineering runs on the local runtime backend.

name: OpenCode coding engine
degradesTo: OpenHands when configured, otherwise the local engineering runtime.

health.detail: OPENCODE_BASE_URL is unset — OpenCode is not an available execution backend.

name: Infisical secrets management
degradesTo: LÉLU's existing env-file contract (.env / .env.local, server-owned credentials). No secret is copied anywhere by this adapter.

health.detail: INFISICAL_API_URL is unset — credentials stay in the existing server environment.

name: OpenTelemetry collector
degradesTo: Traces stay in LÉLU's in-process ring buffer, visible in the monitor and exportable as JSON. Nothing is shipped off-machine.

health.detail: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is unset — traces are local only, and the monitor says so.
